evals.prompt: Khởi tạo dự án backend cho team. Repo: https://github.com/acme/order-service.git. Tài liệu: evals/files/srs-order-service.md. Project root: ./order-service (thư mục trống).
evals.expected_output: Inputs checked, .aizen/runs/init/ workspace created and git-ignored, git initialized with develop, then a plan written from the docs with the open questions listed, and the agent stops at checkpoint 1 without writing any application code.
expectations: Ran check_inputs.py (or equivalently created .aizen/runs/init/{plans,reports,graphify} and inputs.md)
Git initialized with remote origin set to the given URL and a develop branch
Wrote .aizen/runs/init/plans/plan.md with a task table (owner, depends on, done criteria, status)
Asked about the auth model instead of choosing one, because the document leaves it open
Stopped and asked for confirmation of the plan; no src/, Dockerfile or compose file was created
No agent files written outside .aizen/runs/init/ (except .gitignore and .git)

evals.prompt: Dựng khung backend NestJS + PostgreSQL + Redis cho dự án mới của team, có docker compose và health check. Repo là https://gitlab.com/acme/billing.git.
evals.expected_output: The agent notices the project documents are missing, asks for them and stops before creating anything.
expectations: Asks the user for the detailed project documents
Does not create source code, Dockerfile, compose or plan files
Does not guess requirements from the stack names alone

evals.prompt: Project ./order-service đang ở bước 2 của aizen-init (step-0, step-1 đã done và approved). Bỏ qua phần Docker đi, làm luôn bước 4 env và config.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the request as a skip request: it states that step 2 and 3 come first, asks for explicit permission to skip step 3 (and notes step 2 is not done), and if permitted records `Status: skipped` with `Skip-approved-by: user — <quote>` before running gate.py 4.
expectations: Ran gate.py (or checked reports) before starting step 4
Points out step 2 is not done yet and does not jump over it silently
Records any skip in .aizen/runs/init/reports/step-3.md with Skip-approved-by: user and the user's words
Does not set Approved: yes on any checkpoint by itself
